title: Trivy (Aqua Security, Apache-2.0): the JSON report the customer's pipeline writes
readScopes: None for the collector: it reads the report file. Trivy runs in the customer's pipeline (`trivy image|fs|config --format json --output <file>`).

checks.title: No high or critical misconfiguration in the infrastructure-as-code Trivy scanned
checks.scope: IaC files (Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, Dockerfile, Helm) in the scanned artifact; resources deployed outside that code are not seen.

checks.title: The container image has no vulnerability at the failing severities (default critical)
checks.scope: OS and language packages in the scanned image, matched against Trivy's database on the day of the scan.

checks.title: The repository's dependencies have no vulnerability at the failing severities (default critical)
checks.scope: Lock files and manifests in the scanned filesystem or repository; dependencies resolved only at build time may be missing.
